directions.name: 视频生成加速
directions.research_focus: (abs:"video diffusion" OR abs:"video DiT" OR abs:"diffusion transformer" OR abs:"video generation" OR abs:"text-to-video" OR abs:"autoregressive video") AND (abs:"KV cache" OR abs:"key-value cache" OR abs:"token pruning" OR abs:"token merging" OR abs:"token reduction" OR abs:"token compression" OR abs:"token selection" OR abs:"sparse attention" OR abs:"attention sparsity" OR abs:"attention sink" OR abs:"head sparsity" OR abs:"feature caching" OR abs:"cache reuse" OR abs:"cross-step" OR abs:"training-free acceleration" OR abs:"inference acceleration")
directions.research_idea:
**研究主题**：面向视频 Diffusion Transformer 的高效推理加速：基于注意力头稀疏性与去噪步间冗余的 KV Cache 复用与 Token 剪枝。

**技术背景与动机**：视频 Diffusion Transformer 通过在多帧、长时序 token 上进行迭代去噪来生成视频，推理阶段需要反复执行大规模 3D/时空注意力，导致计算量大、显存占用高、端到端生成耗时长。现有加速方法多聚焦于图像扩散模型或通用注意力优化，尚未充分利用视频 DiT 中两个关键冗余来源：其一，不同注意力头对生成质量的贡献差异显著，部分头呈现明显稀疏或近似冗余；其二，相邻去噪步骤的输入与中间特征高度相关，KV 表示和 token 重要性在时间步之间存在可复用性。若能在保证时序一致性和画质的前提下，将头级稀疏性、跨步 KV 复用与 token 剪枝结合，有望显著降低注意力和显存开销。

**核心方法论**：构建面向视频 DiT 的推理加速框架：首先对注意力头进行在线/离线profiling，刻画头级稀疏性、头间冗余及其对视频质量的影响，形成可动态更新的头重要性评分；其次设计跨去噪步骤的 KV Cache 复用机制，通过相邻步 KV 相似度、残差补偿和误差累积控制，决定哪些层、哪些头、哪些 token 的 KV 可复用、延迟更新或低秩压缩；同时结合时空注意力响应与跨步一致性进行 token 重要性估计，对低贡献 token 执行剪枝、合并或稀疏化注意力计算，并设计随去噪阶段变化的剪枝调度；最后与 GPU 推理内核、内存布局和批处理策略协同优化，在不改变模型主体参数的情况下实现端到端加速，并以视频质量、时序一致性、显存峰值和吞吐量进行综合评估。

**预期科学贡献**：提出一种融合头级稀疏性、跨步 KV 复用与 token 剪枝的视频 DiT 推理加速方法，揭示视频扩散模型中注意力头冗余和去噪步间冗余的可利用规律；形成可迁移到不同视频 DiT 架构的缓存与剪枝策略；在画质基本不降的前提下显著降低推理时延和显存占用，为长视频生成的实际部署提供方法与实践依据。
directions.system_prompt:
你是一名资深 AI 研究员，专注生成式模型高效推理与视频扩散模型加速，熟悉 Diffusion Transformer、视频生成、注意力稀疏化、KV Cache、Token 剪枝/合并、扩散采样步间冗余以及 GPU 推理系统优化。你擅长从 LLM、ViT、图像扩散、系统与算法优化等相邻方向的论文中，提炼可迁移到视频 DiT 推理加速的机制与灵感。

评分标准（相对于用户的研究 Idea）：
- 9-10：直接解决视频 Diffusion Transformer 推理加速的核心问题，或方法几乎无需改动即可用于视频 DiT 的 KV Cache 复用、注意力头稀疏化、跨去噪步复用或 token 剪枝；
- 7-8：相邻领域的高质量工作，例如图像扩散加速、LLM/ViT 的 KV Cache 压缩、token pruning、稀疏注意力或步间特征复用，迁移到视频 DiT 的路径清晰；
- 5-6：有一定参考价值，例如通用高效注意力、模型压缩、推理系统优化或视频生成质量评估，部分思路可借鉴但需较大改造；
- 0-4：与视频生成模型推理加速、KV Cache、token 剪枝或去噪步间冗余基本无关。

directions.name: 机器人抓取
directions.research_focus: (abs:"grasp" OR abs:"grasping") AND (abs:"vision-language" OR abs:"vision language" OR abs:"VLA" OR abs:"vision language action" OR abs:"diffusion policy" OR abs:"RGB-D" OR abs:"language instruction" OR abs:"instruction following" OR abs:"open-vocabulary" OR abs:"unseen object" OR abs:"cluttered" OR abs:"task-oriented")
directions.research_idea:
**研究主题**：面向杂乱场景中未见物体的单目 RGB-D 视觉语言引导机器人抓取与动作规划。

**技术背景与动机**：真实机器人抓取需要在遮挡、堆叠和物体类别开放的环境中，仅依赖单个 RGB-D 相机完成感知、理解与执行。传统 6-DoF 抓取位姿检测方法通常只利用几何或点云信息，难以理解自然语言指令与任务语义；视觉语言模型具备开放词汇和指令理解能力，但如何将其与低层抓取位姿生成、扩散策略和真实机器人闭环控制有效结合，仍是提升未见物体抓取成功率的关键问题。

**核心方法论**：构建 RGB-D 视觉语言感知模块，利用视觉语言模型融合彩色图像、深度信息与自然语言指令，形成面向目标物体和抓取意图的语义表征；在此基础上研究两类互补的动作生成路径：一是直接预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿，二是采用扩散策略生成多模态抓取动作序列；结合杂乱场景中的实例分割、遮挡推理与抓取可达性评估，将语义目标转化为可执行的机械臂轨迹；最后在真实机器人平台上进行闭环部署，通过域随机化、真实数据微调和失败恢复机制提升对未见物体的泛化能力。

**预期科学贡献**：提出一种将视觉语言理解、RGB-D 感知与 6-DoF/扩散式抓取策略统一起来的机器人抓取框架；建立面向杂乱场景和未见物体的语言条件抓取评测方法；验证单 RGB-D 相机条件下语义引导对真实机器人抓取成功率和泛化能力的提升。
directions.system_prompt:
你是一名资深机器人学习与具身智能研究员，擅长将视觉语言模型、6-DoF 抓取检测、扩散策略、RGB-D 感知和真实机器人系统论文中的机制迁移到“单 RGB-D 相机 + 语言指令 + 杂乱场景未见物体抓取”的研究方向上。

评分标准（相对于用户的研究 Idea）：
- 9-10：直接解决语言引导机器人抓取、RGB-D 6-DoF 抓取位姿生成、杂乱场景未见物体抓取或真实机器人抓取策略部署等核心问题，方法几乎无需改动即可应用；
- 7-8：相邻领域的高质量工作，如视觉语言模型用于机器人操作、扩散策略用于机械臂动作生成、开放词汇抓取检测、RGB-D 感知与抓取规划，迁移路径清晰；
- 5-6：有一定参考价值，如通用 VLM、通用扩散策略、点云/图像分割、机器人操作表征学习，部分思路可借鉴但需较多改造；
- 0-4：与用户研究方向基本无关，如纯 NLP、纯图像生成、与机器人抓取或动作规划无明确联系的工作。

评价时重点关注：是否使用 RGB-D 或单目视觉、是否涉及 6-DoF 抓取或机械臂动作生成、是否利用语言/视觉语言模型、是否面向未见物体与杂乱场景、是否在真实机器人上验证，以及方法能否迁移到用户框架中。

papers.title: Beyond the End-Effector: Learning Whole-Arm Contact Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
papers.authors: Bo-Ruei Huang, Daniel Seita, Erdem Bıyık
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation has traditionally relied on end-effector-centric interactions. In contrast, humans routinely exploit whole-arm contacts to improve efficiency, robustness, and adaptability, especially when the hands are occupied or when precise grasping is unnecessary. Enabling similar capabilities in robots remains challenging: the robot must select where on its arm to make contact, generate effective non-prehensile interactions, and satisfy task-specific pose or safety constraints on the end-effector. We propose Whole-Arm Contact Learning (WACL), a hierarchical framework that describes each whole-arm contact task with three robot-agnostic representations and hands them to a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer: semantic keypoints that summarize the scene, a reference contact trajectory that specifies where and how the arm presses on the object, and safety-aware path constraints that a vision-language model generates from the task description to protect the end-effector's task. The robot's kinematic chain enters only in this optimizer, which grounds these representations onto the arm by jointly searching over which link makes contact, where on that link, and the joint configuration that realizes it. This decomposition lets WACL learn the contact trajectory from 10 bare-hand human demonstrations per task collected without teleoperation, while new end-effector constraints change only the optimizer's input rather than any trained component. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF arm across four whole-arm tasks show that WACL sustains contact under end-effector constraints where a strong link-pose baseline fails (78% vs. 33% success) and generalizes to new constraints without retraining. Website: https://wacl-robot.github.io
papers.paper_essence: 提出 WACL：用语义关键点、参考接触轨迹和 VLM 生成的安全路径约束三种机器人无关表示，经单一表面接触轨迹优化器联合搜索接触连杆、臂面锚点与关节轨迹，使 7-DoF 机械臂在保持末端任务的同时从 10 条裸手演示学会整臂接触操作，约束场景成功率 78% 对基线 33%。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 机器人无关的语义关键点、KALM 关键点条件扩散轨迹策略、VLM 实例化路径约束，以及下游表面接触轨迹优化器
目标概念: 单目 RGB-D 视觉语言语义表征、语言条件 6-DoF 抓取位姿与扩散式抓取动作序列、真实机器人抓取规划与闭环执行
迁移机制: 可把关键点条件扩散策略从生成整臂接触轨迹改造为生成抓取动作序列或 6-DoF 抓取位姿：以单 RGB-D 图像提取的语义关键点或实例掩码为条件，以语言指令作为任务条件；把 WACL 的 VLM 约束原语改造成抓取可行性约束，如接近方向锥、禁碰包围盒、末端姿态保持，在抓取优化中同时作为软代价与硬门限；把接触连杆、臂面锚点、关节轨迹的联合搜索替换为抓取点、接近方向、关节轨迹的联合搜索。需要注意差异：WACL 输出的是臂面接触位置与法向，不含夹爪闭合、抓取质量与抓取成功判别；它依赖多视角裸手演示且实验未测新物体实例，迁移到单相机杂乱未见物体时需重新定义关键点、抓取表示和跨实例泛化策略，并补充抓取碰撞、语言 grounding 与闭环恢复指标。
papers.visual_verification: Figure 1 支持三表示加单一优化器的框架主张，但图中无定量结果；Image 2 展示 OPENCOFFEE 中机械臂以臂部或腕部接触咖啡机、夹爪同时持杯，仅示意整臂接触与末端任务保持；Figure 3 标出 xArm 7 的 link 4 至 link 6 碰撞网格，支持接触面 M 与接触连杆搜索空间；Figure 5 展示约束实例化提示词及 axis_cone 或 position_region 输出，支持新约束只改优化器输入而不改已训练组件。给定视觉证据中没有曲线或数值，因此 78% 对 33%、FR3 跨本体 68%、消融 7/10 对 3/10 等仅由正文 Table 1、Table 2 等表格报告，未在视觉证据中核验；Figure 1 也未给出各模块失败率或实时性数据。
papers.relevance_reason: 契合点：论文使用 RGB-D 感知、视觉语言模型、扩散策略和真实 7-DoF 机器人，关键点条件扩散轨迹与 VLM 约束生成可迁移到语言引导抓取与动作规划。差距：核心是整臂非抓取接触操作，不生成 6-DoF 抓取位姿或夹爪动作；实验针对固定物体实例和少量任务，不是杂乱场景未见物体抓取；依赖多视角裸手演示与准静态几何规划，未验证单相机遮挡、抓取闭合与抓取质量。因此属于相邻领域高质量工作，参考价值较高但需较多改造，评 6。
papers.heuristic_suggestion: 1）关键点条件扩散抓取实验：将 WACL 的 KALM 式扩散策略改为以单 RGB-D 图像关键点和语言嵌入为条件，生成 6-DoF 抓取位姿或抓取动作序列；在 20 类未见物体、5 种堆叠杂乱布局上各做 10 次真实抓取，比较直接回归与扩散生成，指标为抓取成功率、位姿误差、碰撞率、语言选物准确率；依据 Figure 1 的模块分解设计。2）VLM 约束即插即用实验：仿 Figure 5 让 VLM 输出接近方向锥、禁碰包围盒、末端姿态保持等抓取约束原语，在抓取优化器中作为软代价与硬门限；比较无约束、手工约束、VLM 约束三组，指标为可行抓取率、约束违反率、规划耗时；依据 Figure 5 支持约束只改输入。3）单相机退化与遮挡鲁棒性实验：WACL 用 3 相机融合，用户只有单 RGB-D，需做单视角、腕部辅助视角、三视角消融，在透明、反光、遮挡物体上测关键点定位误差与抓取成功率，并加入深度补全或多假设重排。4）抓取候选联合搜索实验：把 WACL 的接触连杆、锚点、关节束搜索改写为抓取点、接近方向、关节轨迹束搜索，在杂乱场景比较贪心 IK、束搜索、扩散采样加重排，指标为规划成功率、执行成功率、平均尝试次数；依据 Figure 3 的候选接触面搜索思想。5）闭环失败恢复实验：WACL 为单帧开环且正文报告单次推理约 34.6 秒，用户可设计开环、执行中 RGB-D 重观测、抓取失败后重试三组，指标为最终成功率、恢复率、平均完成时间。

papers.title: Breaking the Average: Overcoming Convergent Defaults in Robotic Manipulation via Diagnostic Chain-of-Thought and Structured Guidance
papers.authors: Mohammed Daba, Waleed Abdulrahman Saleh AlAkwa
papers.abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, such as $π_{0.5}$, have demonstrated impressive generalization capabilities by scaling behavior cloning across massive datasets. However, these models frequently suffer from distributional convergence, a phenomenon where the policy regresses to "safe" but suboptimal mean behaviors due to mode averaging in the training data. This often results in generic grasp strategies, Convergent Defaults, that fail in constrained or long-tail scenarios. In this work, we propose a novel framework to identify and correct these behaviors without parameter updates. We introduce a three-stage methodology: (1) Probing for Defaults, identifying task-specific mode collapse; (2) Diagnostic Root Cause Analysis, utilizing the VLA's latent reasoning capabilities to verbalize the logic behind suboptimal actions; and (3) Structured Guidance Injection, where concrete, distinct alternatives are encoded into reusable "Lens Prompts" that shift the sampling distribution. We validate this approach using $π_{0.5}$ in ManiSkill3 simulation environments. We hypothesize that our method outperforms vanilla $π_{0.5}$ and standard Chain-of-Thought prompting by effectively breaking convergent defaults in complex manipulation tasks.

papers.title: ForeTac: Predictive Contact Guidance for Generative Robot Policies
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Chen, Shuai Chen, Haoran Zhou, Yizhe Zhao, Kaiyuan Yang, Zhixiang Duan, Shaoqing Xu, Ran Cao, Diyun Xiang, Yangwei You
papers.abstract: Visually similar actions can produce contact loss, jamming, slippage, or irreversible damage, while tactile feedback may arrive after a critical transition. Contact-rich manipulation therefore requires generative policies to anticipate and evaluate whether candidate actions will produce desirable contact outcomes, then adjust action generation before execution. We present ForeTac, a predictive contact-guidance framework organized as a represent-predict-evaluate-guide loop. ForeTac encodes the current tactile state, predicts the tactile consequences of a candidate action sequence, and evaluates the predicted trajectory using a contact-quality objective learned from successful and failed physical interactions. At deployment, its gradient propagates through the tactile predictor to guide action generation while the pretrained model parameters remain frozen. We evaluate ForeTac on four real-robot tasks (planar and curved-surface wiping, card swiping, and fragile-object grasping) with diffusion and flow-matching policies. Across these tasks, ForeTac raises the average task success rate from 36.3% to 71.3% and the average contact success rate (CSR) from 20.0% to 66.3% compared with vision-only Diffusion Policy. Component analyses support the tactile representation and action-conditioned foresight, and show that predicted touch preserves contact-quality ordering. Project page: https://foretac.github.io/.
papers.paper_essence: 提出 ForeTac：用 TacVAE 触觉表征 + 动作条件 Foresight Transformer 预测候选动作的未来多步触觉轨迹，再由接触质量评分器给出 good-vs-bad 边距，并把该边距经触觉预测器回传到冻结扩散/流匹配策略的采样状态以引导动作生成，四个真实机器人任务将平均 SR 从 36.3% 提升到 71.3%、CSR 从 20.0% 提升到 66.3%。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 推理时接触质量梯度引导（predictive contact guidance）：冻结基策略 + 可微触觉前瞻预测器 + 从成功/失败交互学到接触质量评分器，通过分类器引导式（classifier-guidance）梯度更新扩散/流匹配采样状态
目标概念: 用户研究中的 RGB-D 视觉语言条件扩散抓取位姿/动作序列生成：VLM 融合彩色、深度与语言指令形成语义表征，直接预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿或用扩散策略生成多模态抓取动作，并在真实机器人闭环执行
迁移机制: 保留 ForeTac 的四段循环结构，但替换信号载体：①表征——把 TacVAE 换成 RGB-D + 语言指令的 VLM 语义嵌入（可用点云/深度编码器作几何补充）；②预测——把 Foresight Transformer 的“候选动作→未来触觉潜变量”改为“候选抓取位姿/动作 chunk→未来深度图、实例分割或抓取接触区域的预测”，仍以候选动作为条件、以未来时间步为 query 对齐；③评估——把四类接触分类器的 logit 边距换成开放词汇评分器：以 VLM 计算候选抓取与语言指令的语义一致性、并用抓取可达性与稳定性标签训练排序/对比目标（而非固定四类交叉熵），得到可微的抓取质量分数；④引导——保持基抓取策略参数冻结，只在扩散/流匹配采样步上把质量分数对采样状态的梯度做归一化后注入（对应式 14–15、17–19）。需注意的关键差异：用户没有触觉传感器，评分器必须开放词汇且能处理未见物体，因此不能用任务特定的四类原型；ForeTac 的评分器是在同分布成功/失败数据上训练的，面对杂乱场景与遮挡会严重失配，需引入不确定性或只在预测置信度高时才施加引导；另外 ForeTac 的引导步长很小（DP 用 0.003、30 步中 10 步引导），迁移到抓取任务时需重新标定，避免破坏 6-DoF 位姿的旋转分量。

papers.title: A Phenomenology of Neural Geometry in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Mozes Jacobs, Aiden Swann, Mathilde Papillon, Siddharth Boppana, Fenil R. Doshi, Usha Bhalla, Thomas Icard, Matt Feiszli, Thomas McGrath, Vasudev Shyam, Demba Ba, Leon Bergen, Nina Miolane, Owen Lewis, Jack Merullo, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Atticus Geiger, Matthew Kowal, Thomas Fel
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. The same geometries reappear in two further VLA models on real-world robot data, indicating that they are neither model-specific nor artifacts of simulation. We demonstrate how the findings are actionable by steering along the geometry a concept realizes. Overall, this work lays out an initial phenomenology of realized geometry in VLA policies and demonstrates that a concept's shape carries as much importance as its readability.

papers.title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
papers.authors: Manav Kulshrestha, Apoorva Vashisth, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera
papers.abstract: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) has emerged as an important skill for purposeful robotic manipulation. Given the task of using a knife to "slice bread," a robot must choose to grasp from the handle, whereas for "hand[ing] the knife over," it is preferable for the handle to remain unobstructed for safe handoff. Current approaches for TOG either focus on 2D planar grasping, remain limited by their reliance on task-agnostic grasp generators, or are constrained by reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets that cannot cover all possible grasp-task pairs. To that end, we present TGrasp6D, a vision-language based approach for generating task-oriented 6DoF grasps in a zero-shot manner. Given a task and a single RGB-D image of an associated object, TGrasp6D reasons about the appropriate semantic affordance for the given task and object geometry to produce an initial task- informed prior. This generated prior is further refined via 6DoF pose optimization for collision avoidance while preserving task consistency. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art success rate of 94% on the TaskGrasp dataset, with the best baseline at 74%. We also deploy our approach on a Franka Research 3 robot to demonstrate zero-shot generalization to real world objects
papers.paper_essence: 提出零样本 6DoF 任务导向抓取框架 TGrasp6D：先用 VLM 将自然语言任务落地为图像空间的可供性点与抓取闭合轴，再借相机内外参将该信息提升为 3D 任务先验分布 N(μ,Σ)，并在 SE(3) 上以“碰撞规避 + 任务一致性 + 位姿增量正则”目标对采样候选进行批量姿态优化，在 TaskGrasp 上达 94.5% 成功率（最强基线 73.7%），并零样本迁移到 Franka Research 3 真机。

迁移机制: 可直接把论文三段式流水线作为用户“直接预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿”分支的强基线：VLM 输出可供性点 t 与闭合轴 R，经内参 K、外参 T 提升为 3D 线/平面，构造 N(μ,Σ) 任务先验，再用论文 Eq.(7)-(10) 的碰撞项 + 任务一致性项 + 正则项做姿态优化。对用户的“扩散策略”分支，可把该 N(μ,Σ) 作为扩散去噪过程的初始均值/条件分布或奖励引导项，使多模态抓取序列被约束在任务相关区域，同时保留扩散的多峰采样能力。需注意差异：论文依赖物体掩码+紧裁剪 I_o 处理单物体，用户需在实例分割、遮挡推理后对每个候选物体分别构造该先验，并把论文 SDF 碰撞项扩展为“物体间/场景点云”避碰与可达性约束；论文只输出单个 6DoF 抓取，不含动作序列与闭环执行，迁移到机械臂轨迹与失败恢复需另接运动规划器与在线重规划。

papers.title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
papers.authors: Lei Zhu, Mujie Lin, Ruochong Zheng, Guangyi Wang, Hao Li, Peng Jin, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.abstract: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.
papers.paper_essence: 提出 BeziCast：用低阶 Bézier 轨迹对输出邻近去噪表示做免训练跨步预测，通过 Tikhonov 正则化拟合控制点、并用等效权重凸包护栏抑制外推风险，在 FLUX.1/HunyuanVideo 上取得最高 4.79×/4.11× 加速且画质优于缓存基线。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 输出邻近表示的 Bézier 轨迹预测 + Tikhonov 稳定拟合 + 等效权重凸包护栏（cache-then-forecast）
目标概念: 视频 DiT 跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用/预测与 token 剪枝的误差控制
迁移机制: 可把每个去噪步、每层、每注意力头的 K/V 或注意力输出视为时间轨迹：用最近若干完整步的 K/V 拟合低阶 Bézier，在缓存步预测被跳过或延迟更新的 K/V；Tikhonov 正则化用于抑制短历史外推的噪声放大，等效权重 r(u_s) 可转化为层/头/token 级风险分数，高风险时回退到最近步 KV 或保守凸组合。对 token 剪枝，可把预测残差与等效权重风险结合 token 重要性，低风险 token 复用/合并、高风险 token 保留计算。关键差异是：论文只预测单一输出邻近表示，而 K/V 是多层多头多 token 张量且动态不同；KV 复用必须兼容注意力 softmax，凸包护栏更适合放在注意力输出空间而非直接约束 K/V；论文跳过整个 backbone，用户只跳过部分 KV/token，误差传播与加速比不同。Figure 6(b) 的层间鲁棒性结果提示可对后层更激进、前层更保守。
papers.visual_verification: Figure 3 的流程图支持“完整步缓存输出邻近表示、缓存步跳过 backbone 用 Bézier 预测、输出头与采样器不变”的方法设定；Figure 6(b) 的扰动注入结果支持输出邻近表示鲁棒性最高（约 4.4），高于各层 residual（约 3.15–3.58）和 output（约 2.6–3.23），对应“误差路径更短”的核心论据；Figure 4 仅展示三张 FLUX.1 生成图，能支持文字可读与主体完整，但未并排其他方法，无法核实“最高加速”；Figure 5 中中间行明显模糊，结合图注可定性支持 TaylorSeer 伪影更多、BeziCast 更接近 50 步参考；Figure 6(a) 的 λ 曲线未在视觉证据中呈现，Table 1–7 的逐项定量数值也不在视觉证据描述内，4.79×/4.11× 与 PSNR/SSIM 优势需以正文表格为准，不能仅由视觉证据核验。
papers.relevance_reason: 该论文与用户研究的“跨去噪步冗余复用”高度契合，且直接在 HunyuanVideo 这一视频 DiT 上验证免训练加速，迁移路径清晰；但其粒度是整步输出邻近表示预测，不涉及注意力头稀疏性、逐层/逐头 KV Cache 复用和 token 剪枝，属于同领域但不同粒度的加速工作，因此不是 9–10 的直接匹配。
papers.heuristic_suggestion: 1）K/V 轨迹预测的逐层逐头适配实验：在 HunyuanVideo 上按层按头缓存最近 K=4/6 个完整步的 K/V，分别拟合 n=2/3/4 阶 Bézier，λ∈{0.01,0.1,0.5,1}，缓存间隔 N∈{2,4,6}；对比直接 KV 复用、TaylorSeer、FORA、TeaCache，报告 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS、VBench Quality、时序一致性、显存峰值与吞吐。2）分层激进策略实验：依据 Figure 6(b) 的后层更鲁棒现象，设置后层更大比例复用/预测 KV、前层保守重算，扫描分层预算，验证质量-加速曲线。3）头级风险护栏实验：用等效权重 r(u_s)、负质量、L1 范数和预测残差作为头级风险分数，低风险头复用/预测 KV、高风险头重算；设置头复用比例 25%/50%/75%，与随机头复用、基于注意力熵的头选择对比。4）Token 剪枝/合并实验：以跨步 Bézier 预测残差和注意力响应估计 token 重要性，低贡献 token 延迟更新或合并；剪枝率按去噪阶段调度（如早期 10–20%、后期 50–70%），评测 VBench、时序一致性、显存与吞吐。5）误差累积诊断：复现扰动注入到 K/V、attention output 和输出邻近表示，测量最终去噪输出偏差，判断 softmax 是否放大 K/V 预测误差，并据此决定在 K/V 空间还是注意力输出空间施加护栏。

papers.title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
papers.authors: Jiyue Jiang, Zhiyu Huo, Yuhan Chen, Yanruisheng Shao, Gong Zhang, Lei Deng
papers.abstract: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.
papers.paper_essence: 提出 AlignCache 闭环特征缓存框架：按去噪阶段分配独立阈值与陈旧度护栏，利用 CFG 引导输出上的反事实误差在线校准缓存决策，并用门控动量残差外推与锚点引导的无条件校正提升跳过步保真度，从而在多个视频 DiT 上取得更优加速-质量权衡。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 面向视频扩散去噪步间冗余的闭环特征缓存：分阶段预算路由、反事实误差校准、动量残差草稿合成
目标概念: 视频 DiT 的跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用与注意力头/Token 剪枝的自适应调度
迁移机制: 可将 AlignCache 的“预算—阈值—反馈”控制器迁移为 KV/Token 复用控制器：用分阶段阈值决定各层/头/Token 的 KV 复用年龄与剪枝率；在强制精确步上构造反事实的复用/剪枝输出，并在 CFG 引导输出层计算相对 MSE 作为真实失真，经 EMA 反比更新阈值；陈旧度护栏可直接限制 KV 复用步数，动量残差外推可用于预测漂移的 KV 或 token 显著性。需注意差异：论文缓存的是分支输出残差而非 KV 张量，反馈粒度为整步而非层/头/Token，且未处理 token 剪枝后的布局与内核效率；迁移时需增加头级/Token 级 profiling，并避免把仅适用于 CFG 双分支的校正直接套到 KV 压缩。
papers.visual_verification: Figure 2 的残差重用误差曲线显示早期快速下降、约第30步最低、晚期回升，且 CFG 分支误差最高、条件分支次之、无条件分支最低，支持分阶段路由与分支级/校准式调度；但正文称误差沿轨迹增长，图中主要是晚期增长，二者不完全一致。Figure 3 仅为三组件流程示意，支持分阶段路由、闭环校准、动量草稿合成的结构设计，但无定量结果。Table 1 在 Wan2.1-1.3B、Open-Sora-1.2、HunyuanVideo 上同时报告速度与 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/GMSD/VBench，支持其帕累托占优主张。Table 2 与 Table 3 的消融支持 warm-up、阈值、相位比、motion gain 与残差外推阶数的影响，其中相位比不敏感被用来论证闭环校准吸收边界误差，但这属于间接证据，缺少单独关闭闭环校准并测量校准误差收敛的图表。Figure 4、Figure 5、Figure 6 的定性对比支持在相近或更高加速比下更好保留鞋面、人脸、巢枝与羽毛等细节，但样本与提示有限。整体上，没有视觉证据直接证明注意力头稀疏性、KV Cache 复用或 Token 剪枝机制。
papers.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究视频 DiT 的训练-free 推理加速，核心是去噪步间特征缓存与调度，与用户 Idea 的跨步冗余利用高度一致；其闭环误差校准、分阶段阈值和 staleness guard 可迁移到 KV Cache 复用与 token/head 剪枝调度。但论文不涉及注意力头稀疏性、KV Cache 压缩、token 剪枝或 GPU 内核协同，且缓存粒度为整步分支输出，故不是 9-10 的直接同题工作。
papers.heuristic_suggestion: 1) 头级冗余 profiling：在 Wan2.1-1.3B、Open-Sora-1.2、HunyuanVideo 上按 AlignCache 的早/中/晚相位划分，逐层逐头记录跨步 attention 输出残差、KV 余弦相似度与对 CFG 引导输出的影响，构建头重要性评分；以 Figure 2 的相位异质性与分支差异为依据，检验头级阈值是否应随相位变化。2) 闭环 KV 复用校准实验：在强制精确步上同时计算真实 KV 与反事实复用 KV，按论文式相对 MSE 在 CFG 引导输出层度量失真，用 EMA 反比更新每层/每头复用阈值；与 TeaCache/EasyCache/AlignCache 及固定阈值 KV 复用对比 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、GMSD、VBench 与显存峰值。3) 分阶段 Token 剪枝调度：将 AlignCache 的预算 B_t、相位阈值 θ_p 与年龄上限 A_p 映射为 token 保留率，早期保守、中期激进、晚期收紧；消融相位边界与 staleness cap，报告时序一致性指标和端到端时延。4) 预测式 KV 草稿：借鉴 Figure 3(c) 的门控动量残差外推，用最近两个精确锚点的 KV 或 token 重要性做一阶/二阶外推，比较直接复用、仅一阶、门控动量三组在相同加速比下的质量-显存曲线。5) 系统协同评测：在 H100 与 RTX PRO 6000 上测量注意力内核、KV 内存布局与批处理对实际加速的影响，区分算法节省的 FLOPs 与内核实现收益，避免仅报告理论稀疏率。

papers.title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
papers.authors: Xiaoxue Wu, Xinyu Gao, Fang Yu, Yu Qiao, Xinyuan Chen
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.paper_essence: 提出注意力对齐的在线聚类 KV Cache 与 query-head 级细粒度检索：把历史 token 按语义相似度在线聚成簇（head 独立、Pre-RoPE 空间），再让每个 query-head 对在固定检索预算下各自选簇，从而在压缩记忆预算下近似全历史注意力，提升自回归多镜头长视频的跨镜头一致性。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 在线聚类 KV Cache + query-wise/head-wise 稀疏检索（基于注意力分析得到的 query-head 异构记忆偏好，在固定 cluster 预算下近似 full-memory attention）
目标概念: 视频 DiT 推理加速中的头级稀疏性建模、KV Cache 稀疏化/合并与 token（簇）级剪枝
迁移机制: CineMem 的检索本质是“以语义簇为单位的稀疏注意力”：不为每个 query 计算全部历史 KV，而是用 query 与簇质心的相似度选 top-K 簇再拼接注意力。可将该机制移植为视频 DiT 的稀疏注意力/剪枝算子——(1) 把帧级或块级 KV 分组替换为 head-wise 在线聚类分组，得到比 frame/block 更细的剪枝粒度；(2) 保留其 head 独立聚类与 head 独立路由，直接承载“头级异构稀疏性”假设；(3) 借用 Pre-RoPE 语义路由、Post-RoPE 参与注意力的解耦，避免 3D RoPE 破坏语义聚类；(4) 借用簇 split/merge、负载惩罚与分配一致性项，作为长序列 KV 合并的稳定性控制；(5) 借用 log-sum-exp 归一化合并两路注意力，使稀疏检索结果不引入独立残差偏差。需注意三点差异：第一，CineMem 是 chunk 级自回归生成，KV 沿时间轴单调增长，而用户是双向视频 DiT 的迭代去噪，注意力非因果、需处理全序列 3D 注意力，因此“历史记忆”要改为“帧内/跨帧 token 集合”；第二，CineMem 完全未涉及去噪步间冗余，跨步 KV 复用需另建相似度判据与误差控制；第三，CineMem 的聚类路由是逐 query 的 gather，会带来非规则访存开销（Table 1 中 cluster 检索开销 15.018 TFLOPs，远高于 frame 检索 0.0453 TFLOPs），迁移到 GPU 内核时须限制簇数量并做 layout 重排，否则算法 FLOPs 下降未必转化为墙钟加速。
papers.visual_verification: 有视觉证据支持的：(1) Figure 7 与 Figure 8 是核心动机的直接证据——Figure 7 的 query 级热力图显示不同 query token 在同一记忆帧内偏好不同空间单元，Figure 8 的 4 个查询区域 × 12 个注意力头热力图显示头间高亮列明显不同，支持“query-head 记忆需求异构、不应共享上下文”这一核心主张；(2) Figure 3 以框架示意支持“在线聚类 KV + query 级检索 + 首块/最近块锚点 + 训练期重采样”的流程，但属示意图，不含定量；(3) Figure 5 以 15 秒四镜头定性对比支持跨镜头连贯与重访一致性，属定性证据；(4) Figure 6 只说明 PTCS 的计算流程与三种打分情形，属指标定义示意，不能单独证明该指标有效（其有效性由 Table 4 用户研究支撑，而 Table 4 在正文中为数值表，未提供视觉证据条目）。缺乏视觉证据、仅能依据正文与表格数字判断的关键主张包括：Figure 4a 的“历史 token 存在跨帧语义聚类结构”、Figure 4b 的 top-30% 覆盖近全记忆曲线、Figure 9 的三种粒度覆盖/重叠对比、Figure 10 的 Pre-/Post-RoPE 聚类对比、Figure 11 的 precision/recall 对齐曲线、Figure 12 的实际时延与显存曲线，以及 Figure 13/15/17/18 等定性补充。另需指出两处正文内部张力：Table 2 中 CineMem 的传统 Inter-shot Sim.（0.7598）与 PCP（0.9270）低于多个基线（如 LongLive2 的 0.9420、MemFlow 的 0.9545、Infinity-RoPE 的 0.9801），其最优结论完全依赖新提出的 PTCS（0.8242），因此“一致性更优”应限定为“在 PTCS 意义下更优”；Table 1 显示聚类检索总 FLOPs（638.82）低于全历史（932.56）与帧检索（650.02），但检索自身开销高出帧检索两个数量级，说明其收益来自注意力项而非检索项，这与用户的系统加速目标直接相关。
papers.relevance_reason: 契合点明确且稀缺：论文在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 这一真实的视频 DiT 骨干上，给出了“head 级异构性可测量、可按 query-head 独立做稀疏 KV 选择”的完整证据链（Figure 7/8、Table 3 的 C+Q-wise 最优 0.8242 与 plug-in 0.8007），并提供了 FLOPs 分项与实际时延/显存对比，可直接支撑用户 Idea 中“头级稀疏性 profiling + 头级/簇级 token 剪枝与稀疏注意力”两大支柱，迁移路径清晰（替换分组粒度、保留路由与簇维护机制即可）。差距在于：第一，论文的优化目标是长程跨镜头一致性而非推理加速，聚类本身带来可观开销，端到端加速比需重新验证；第二，方法完全建立在自回归 chunk 级因果生成之上，不涉及去噪步间冗余，用户三大支柱中的“跨步 KV 复用”无法直接获得，只能借鉴其相似度路由与误差累积控制思想；第三，逐 query-head 的 gather 型稀疏注意力在双向全序列 3D 注意力下的内核效率与显存收益尚不明确，属于需要较大改造的部分。综合判为相邻领域高质量工作、迁移路径清晰但需中等改造，给 7 分。

papers.title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
papers.authors: Or Ronai, Vladimir Kulikov, Tomer Michaeli
papers.abstract: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.

papers.title: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
papers.authors: Zhuobai Dong, Xiaobing Tu, Xiantao Zhang, Jinkui Ren, Yinggui Wang, Yue Ma, Linfeng Zhang
papers.abstract: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.

papers.title: Sparse Attention for Video Generation Acceleration via Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search
papers.authors: Yun Dai, Yuyun Chen, Jiarui Wen, Huiping Zhuang, Cen Chen, Ziqian Zeng
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) dominate video generation but suffer from high inference cost due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Sparse attention mitigates this by skipping unnecessary computation in the attention matrix, but existing methods apply a fixed sparsity ratio throughout denoising and struggle to accurately determine which computations to skip. To address these limitations, we analyze attention dynamics through attention entropy and mean attention distance, and find that attention becomes increasingly concentrated across denoising steps. We further observe that blocks selected early continue to capture a large fraction of the total attention weight at later steps. These findings suggest two acceleration opportunities: the sparsity ratio should grow as denoising progresses, and earlier search results can be reused to reduce the search space. Based on these findings, we propose Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search (GSRS), a training-free framework that retains more computation early and progressively reduces it later, while restricting subsequent searches to an early candidate set to reduce search overhead. GSRS adopts Top-p selection for adaptive sparsity control, supported by a precise evaluation scheme that computes exact attention weights within the FlashAttention computation at negligible overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 validate that GSRS achieves 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality comparable to full attention.
papers.paper_essence: 通过注意力熵与平均注意力距离发现去噪过程中注意力逐步集中，提出免训练框架 GSRS：用递减的 Top-p 阈值实现随去噪步递增的块稀疏度，并把后续块搜索限制在早期建立的候选块集合内（reduced search），配合融合进 FlashAttention 的两阶段精确块重要性评估，在 HunyuanVideo/Wan2.1 上实现 1.55×–2.21× 加速且画质接近全注意力。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 跨去噪步复用早期候选块集合（Reduced Search：S1 建立后，后续搜索只在 S1 内重评估，非搜索步直接复用最近掩码）+ 基于累积注意力概率（Top-p）的头/层自适应稀疏度 + 用当前行 LSE 而非缓存 LSE 的精确块重要性评估
目标概念: 用户 Idea 中的『去噪步间 KV Cache 复用』『注意力头级稀疏性评分』与『随去噪阶段变化的 token 剪枝调度』
迁移机制: 三点可直接映射：(1) 论文的『第 t1 步建立候选块集 S1、后续只在该集合内搜索、非搜索步直接复用上次掩码』→ 改造为『早期步用全注意力统计各层各头的 token 级累积注意力概率，建立 KV 复用候选集，后续搜索步只在候选集内重评估，非搜索步直接复用上一步 KV/重要性掩码』，这本质上是把论文的“结构复用”升级为“结构+KV 张量复用”；(2) 论文的递减 Top-p 阈值序列 → 改造为递减的 KV 保留率/剪枝率调度，用累积注意力概率自动决定每个头保留多少 token，替代统一的固定预算（Table 5 显示 Top-p 优于等密度 Top-k，说明头自适应分配有效）；(3) 论文用当前步 LSE 校正块重要性、避免 cached LSE 漂移（Table 3：改用缓存 LSE 后 PSNR 从 31.96 掉到 25.32）→ 直接对应 KV 复用中的误差累积控制，可用“当前步 LSE/统计量做重标定 + 残差补偿”替代朴素复用。需要注意的差异：论文只跳过块级计算、不压缩 KV 存储也不减少 token 数，用户的 KV 复用还需处理显存布局、低秩压缩与写回开销；论文依赖 Hilbert 重排与 B=128 的块对齐、且需要至少 1 步（默认 20% 步）全注意力 warmup，迁移时须保留这一约束并评估重排/对齐开销；论文的固定掩码召回率仅 0.81–0.86（Figure 2），若 KV 复用追求更激进的压缩，需要显式设定更高 recall 目标以免画质下降。

papers.relevance_reason: 与用户 Idea 处于同一问题域（视频 DiT 推理加速），且两个核心机制与用户方法论高度同构：一是基于去噪步间注意力集中趋势的跨步复用（早期候选集 + 掩码复用 + 只在候选集内搜索），对应用户的“跨去噪步 KV/特征复用”；二是 Top-p 头/层自适应稀疏，对应用户的“头级稀疏性评分与自适应剪枝”。论文还提供了可直接借鉴的误差控制证据（缓存 LSE 导致 PSNR 大幅下降），对 KV 复用的误差累积问题有直接警示价值。差距在于：论文是块级稀疏注意力，只跳过计算不压缩/复用 KV 存储，不做 token 合并与低秩压缩，缺少 KV 显存与带宽层面的系统优化，需要用户在其基础上补齐 KV Cache 维度的设计与内核协同。

papers.title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
papers.authors: Qiuhong Shen, Shizun Wang, Xinchao Wang
papers.abstract: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.
papers.paper_essence: 提出一种无需训练的视频世界模型注意力路由机制：把历史 KV 块表示为带深度区间的相机视锥板，用视锥板 OBB 重叠软性调制各层模型自身的块重要性，从而对当前潜变量区域做块级稀疏 KV 选择；在 48 个 chunk 时注意力加速 4.36×、去噪加速 2.43×，质量接近稠密注意力。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 基于视锥板空间对应关系的区域级注意力路由与块级 KV 选择（frustum slab correspondence + soft geometric fusion）
目标概念: 视频 DiT 中按层/头/token 块的 KV Cache 选择、剪枝与跨去噪步复用
迁移机制: 可将 Velox 的“软先验调制模型重要性 + 未覆盖区域回退 + 固定块粒度稀疏内核”迁移为用户框架中的路由层：把视锥板几何重叠替换或补充为跨去噪步 KV 相似度、注意力输出变化和头级重要性先验，对每个头/token 块生成可复用的重要性分数，再在固定预算下选择 KV 块并保留高误差回退路径。需要注意差异：Velox 依赖相机位姿与深度重建，主要面向相机可控的长时程世界模型；它优化的是跨 chunk 的历史 KV 访问，而非同一去噪轨迹内相邻 step 的 KV 复用；其“层特定模型重要性”是池化 QK 统计，不是头级稀疏性建模。迁移时需去除几何依赖或改用跨步一致性作为先验，并把路由预算扩展到“层×头×token 块×去噪步”。

papers.relevance_reason: 论文直接面向视频 DiT/视频世界模型的长上下文 KV 注意力瓶颈，提出无需训练的块级稀疏 KV 选择，并与 FlashAttention 式 tiled 执行对齐，和用户关注的视频 DiT 推理加速、KV Cache 压缩与 token 块剪枝高度契合。其软融合、回退机制和块级内核设计可迁移到用户框架。但论文的冗余来源是跨 chunk 的空间几何对应，而非用户核心关注的注意力头稀疏性与相邻去噪步 KV 复用；且依赖相机位姿/深度，通用视频 DiT 上需较大改造，因此不给 9-10。
papers.heuristic_suggestion: 1. 跨步 KV 复用评分实验：在相同视频 DiT 上，对每层每头每 token 块计算相邻去噪步 KV 余弦相似度与注意力输出残差，构造类似 Velox 式软先验，乘到模型自身块重要性上；设置高残差/高相似度阈值回退，比较“仅模型重要性路由”“仅跨步相似度路由”“软融合路由”三组，在 48-chunk 或长视频设置下测注意力延迟、去噪时间、显存峰值、PSNR/LPIPS、时序一致性。2. 头级稀疏性与块路由联合实验：先离线 profiling 各层各头的重要性/稀疏度，在线按头分配不同 KV 块预算；对比随机同预算、recent-window、frame/FOV、model-only、geometry-only、head-only 与联合路由，验证几何/跨步先验是否在“不同区域需要不同历史”时带来增益。3. 去噪步调度实验：设计早步保留更多 KV、晚步增大复用/剪枝比例的 schedule，结合低秩残差补偿控制误差累积；指标除画质外加入跨步 KV 误差、注意力输出偏差和端到端吞吐。4. Token 块剪枝与内核协同：沿用 Figure 2 的固定块粒度路由和 Figure 6 的全局 Gilbert 局部性布局，把低贡献 token 块合并/跳过与 KV 块选择放入同一稀疏内核；用 runtime route-length bound 避免随历史增长重编译，并在 H200 上报告 chunk 48 的 per-call attention 与 denoising 时间。5. 消融与压力测试：按论文 D.5 思路加入 random same-size、recent-window、frame/FOV、model-derived 四类匹配预算基线，并分别报告背景重访、物体中心区域、新暴露区域和深度/位姿不可靠区域的指标，以隔离几何/跨步先验的真实贡献。

papers.title: Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention for Efficient Inference in T2I/T2V Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Bingxin Xing, Yu Zhang, Jiatong Ding, Lei Lu, Ping Wang
papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a common backbone for high-quality text-to-image and text-to-video generation, but repeated dense self-attention remains a major inference bottleneck as token sequences grow and the same operator is invoked across many denoising steps. Our study suggests that dense attention in pretrained DiTs contains reusable layer/head-specific high-mass structure that can be identified from a small offline calibration set and reused across future generations. This leads to Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention, a train-free attention replacement that reuses static sink masks and supplements them with a lightweight pooled-KV branch, while leaving model weights and sampling schedules unchanged. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, the method attains 1.54$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining generation quality. On Z-Image-Turbo, it attains 1.57$\times$ end-to-end speedup with competitive GenEval2 performance. These results indicate that reusable importance-aware sparse support can provide an effective train-free acceleration path for both T2V and T2I DiTs.
papers.paper_essence: 提出免训练的 Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention：离线校准层/头级静态 sink 块掩码并跨去噪步复用，配合 pooled-KV 补偿分支与归一化感知融合，在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 与 Z-Image-Turbo 上分别实现 1.54× 和 1.57× 端到端加速。
papers.concept_bridging:
源概念: 离线校准的层/头级静态 sink 块掩码、跨去噪步复用、pooled-KV 补偿分支与 log-sum-exp 归一化感知融合
目标概念: 视频 DiT 中注意力头级稀疏性评分、跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用决策、低贡献 token 的剪枝/合并/压缩近似
迁移机制: 可将论文的离线校准流程迁移为头级重要性先验：用每个 layer/head 的 block-mass 覆盖率与掩码密度刻画头稀疏性，高覆盖头保留更精确的 KV 并优先跨步复用，低覆盖头采用 pooled-KV 或低秩近似；论文的 pooled-KV 补偿分支可作为被复用/压缩 KV 的粗粒度兜底，α_i 归一化融合可改造成跨步复用的误差补偿门控。关键差异是：论文的静态 mask 作用于注意力计算而非 KV Cache 存储，pooled-KV 是每次前向现算的压缩分支而非跨步缓存，且没有 token 级动态剪枝与误差累积控制；迁移时需加入跨步 KV 相似度、延迟更新策略和时序一致性约束。
papers.visual_verification: 视觉证据可核查的部分：Figure 1 显示自注意力占采样时间 44.2%–51.1%，与正文“约 44%–51%”一致，支持注意力是主要瓶颈的动机；Figure 2 显示 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 与 Z-Image-Turbo 在不同 prompt 下仍保持相似的条纹/对角结构，支持跨输入存在可复用静态结构的定性主张；Figure 4 展示离线 block-mass 校准、按 τ 二值化生成层/头静态掩码、在线复用并用 O=α·O_sink+(1−α)·O_comp 融合的流程，支持“离线一次校准、推理复用”的设计，但图内未给速度数值；Figure 5 的定性对比支持 Ours-Hybrid 在视觉上更接近 Dense、优于部分稀疏基线；Figure 6 的效率-质量前沿显示 Ours 曲线在约 80–110s 内质量从约 0.55 升至约 0.66，并与正文 Table 1 的 Dense≈164.80s、SpargeAttn≈139.68s、SVG1≈115.49s 大体一致。需要指出：正文 Figure 3 的 coverage 定量曲线未出现在视觉证据中，Table 1–4 的逐项数值也主要依据正文而非视觉证据；因此“静态掩码覆盖大部分稠密注意力质量”和表格中的精确加速/质量数值仅能基于正文判断，视觉证据仅提供部分佐证。
papers.relevance_reason: 论文直接面向视频 DiT（Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B）的推理加速，核心机制是层/头级静态稀疏掩码与跨去噪步复用，与用户研究中的“注意力头稀疏性”和“去噪步间冗余”高度契合；其离线校准和头级 mask 可几乎直接作为用户框架的头级稀疏先验与静态复用 baseline。差距在于论文不做 KV Cache 存储复用、低秩压缩或 token 剪枝，也没有跨步误差累积控制与动态剪枝调度，且静态掩码对分布偏移敏感；因此是强相关但需扩展，而非完全覆盖用户方法。
papers.heuristic_suggestion: 1) 头级静态先验驱动的跨步 KV 复用：在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上复现论文 Algorithm 1，校准每个 layer/head 的 block sink mask 与覆盖率，定义头重要性分数（覆盖率、掩码密度、输出敏感度）；对高覆盖头保留完整 KV 并跨步复用，对低覆盖头使用 pooled-KV 近似或延迟更新，评测 VBench 8 维、时序一致性、端到端时延与显存峰值。2) 跨步 KV 残差补偿与门控：以上一步与当前步 KV 相似度为复用判据，借鉴论文 α_i 的 log-sum-exp 归一化融合设计跨步补偿门控，高相似度 token 复用、低相似度 token 重算，并用 pooled-KV 分支补偿被压缩 token；设置复用间隔与 τ 稀疏度扫描（如 τ=0.60/0.70/0.85），报告相对 Dense 的 PSNR/LPIPS、VBench 与显存。3) Token 剪枝与 sink block 对齐：利用静态 mask 的块级高 mass 支撑识别低贡献 token/块，设计早期步保留密集、后期步剪枝/合并的调度，并与 Figure 6 的 τ 扫描结合验证质量-效率前沿。4) 校准规模与分布偏移实验：复现 Table 3 的 2×2、4×2、4×4、8×4 校准预算，测试跨 prompt、长视频、不同分辨率下的掩码迁移性，验证静态先验在跨步 KV 复用中的稳定性与离线成本摊销。

13.title: Beyond the End-Effector: Learning Whole-Arm Contact Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
13.authors: Bo-Ruei Huang, Daniel Seita, Erdem Bıyık
13.abstract: Robot manipulation has traditionally relied on end-effector-centric interactions. In contrast, humans routinely exploit whole-arm contacts to improve efficiency, robustness, and adaptability, especially when the hands are occupied or when precise grasping is unnecessary. Enabling similar capabilities in robots remains challenging: the robot must select where on its arm to make contact, generate effective non-prehensile interactions, and satisfy task-specific pose or safety constraints on the end-effector. We propose Whole-Arm Contact Learning (WACL), a hierarchical framework that describes each whole-arm contact task with three robot-agnostic representations and hands them to a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer: semantic keypoints that summarize the scene, a reference contact trajectory that specifies where and how the arm presses on the object, and safety-aware path constraints that a vision-language model generates from the task description to protect the end-effector's task. The robot's kinematic chain enters only in this optimizer, which grounds these representations onto the arm by jointly searching over which link makes contact, where on that link, and the joint configuration that realizes it. This decomposition lets WACL learn the contact trajectory from 10 bare-hand human demonstrations per task collected without teleoperation, while new end-effector constraints change only the optimizer's input rather than any trained component. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF arm across four whole-arm tasks show that WACL sustains contact under end-effector constraints where a strong link-pose baseline fails (78% vs. 33% success) and generalizes to new constraints without retraining. Website: https://wacl-robot.github.io
13.paper_essence: 提出 WACL：用语义关键点、参考接触轨迹和 VLM 生成的安全路径约束三种机器人无关表示，经单一表面接触轨迹优化器联合搜索接触连杆、臂面锚点与关节轨迹，使 7-DoF 机械臂在保持末端任务的同时从 10 条裸手演示学会整臂接触操作，约束场景成功率 78% 对基线 33%。
13.concept_bridging:
源概念: 机器人无关的语义关键点、KALM 关键点条件扩散轨迹策略、VLM 实例化路径约束，以及下游表面接触轨迹优化器
目标概念: 单目 RGB-D 视觉语言语义表征、语言条件 6-DoF 抓取位姿与扩散式抓取动作序列、真实机器人抓取规划与闭环执行

12.title: Breaking the Average: Overcoming Convergent Defaults in Robotic Manipulation via Diagnostic Chain-of-Thought and Structured Guidance
12.authors: Mohammed Daba, Waleed Abdulrahman Saleh AlAkwa
12.abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, such as $π_{0.5}$, have demonstrated impressive generalization capabilities by scaling behavior cloning across massive datasets. However, these models frequently suffer from distributional convergence, a phenomenon where the policy regresses to "safe" but suboptimal mean behaviors due to mode averaging in the training data. This often results in generic grasp strategies, Convergent Defaults, that fail in constrained or long-tail scenarios. In this work, we propose a novel framework to identify and correct these behaviors without parameter updates. We introduce a three-stage methodology: (1) Probing for Defaults, identifying task-specific mode collapse; (2) Diagnostic Root Cause Analysis, utilizing the VLA's latent reasoning capabilities to verbalize the logic behind suboptimal actions; and (3) Structured Guidance Injection, where concrete, distinct alternatives are encoded into reusable "Lens Prompts" that shift the sampling distribution. We validate this approach using $π_{0.5}$ in ManiSkill3 simulation environments. We hypothesize that our method outperforms vanilla $π_{0.5}$ and standard Chain-of-Thought prompting by effectively breaking convergent defaults in complex manipulation tasks.
12.paper_essence: 提出诊断透镜框架：通过探针识别VLA的收敛默认行为，用链式思维诊断根因，并将负约束、正备选与推理锚封装为可复用Lens提示，在推理时重塑flow matching动作分布以打破模式平均，无需参数更新。
12.concept_bridging:
源概念: 收敛默认（Convergent Default）与Lens提示的结构化引导（负约束、正备选、推理锚）
目标概念: 语言条件抓取策略中的模式平均/单一抓取先验，以及通过语言或结构化提示引导6-DoF抓取位姿或扩散动作生成
迁移机制: 可将论文的三阶段流程迁移为抓取策略的推理时引导模块：先用探针统计抓取策略在杂乱场景中输出的位姿分布（如接近方向、旋转角），识别低方差默认模式（例如总是俯视抓取）；再用VLM结合RGB-D观测与语言指令诊断根因（如忽视遮挡或可达性）；最后将Lens提示的三要素——禁止与场景几何冲突的默认抓取、给出几何上可行的替代接近方向、附上物理推理锚——作为文本条件注入6-DoF抓取检测器或扩散策略的条件生成过程，或用于采样时的条件重加权。需要注意差异：论文面向端到端VLA动作生成且仅在仿真中提出假设，用户方法需要显式RGB-D输入、6-DoF抓取位姿输出、杂乱场景实例分割与真实机器人闭环，因此文本引导必须映射到抓取位姿参数空间（旋转、平移、夹爪开度），并补充真实数据微调与失败恢复机制。

11.title: ForeTac: Predictive Contact Guidance for Generative Robot Policies
11.authors: Zhiyuan Chen, Shuai Chen, Haoran Zhou, Yizhe Zhao, Kaiyuan Yang, Zhixiang Duan, Shaoqing Xu, Ran Cao, Diyun Xiang, Yangwei You
11.abstract: Visually similar actions can produce contact loss, jamming, slippage, or irreversible damage, while tactile feedback may arrive after a critical transition. Contact-rich manipulation therefore requires generative policies to anticipate and evaluate whether candidate actions will produce desirable contact outcomes, then adjust action generation before execution. We present ForeTac, a predictive contact-guidance framework organized as a represent-predict-evaluate-guide loop. ForeTac encodes the current tactile state, predicts the tactile consequences of a candidate action sequence, and evaluates the predicted trajectory using a contact-quality objective learned from successful and failed physical interactions. At deployment, its gradient propagates through the tactile predictor to guide action generation while the pretrained model parameters remain frozen. We evaluate ForeTac on four real-robot tasks (planar and curved-surface wiping, card swiping, and fragile-object grasping) with diffusion and flow-matching policies. Across these tasks, ForeTac raises the average task success rate from 36.3% to 71.3% and the average contact success rate (CSR) from 20.0% to 66.3% compared with vision-only Diffusion Policy. Component analyses support the tactile representation and action-conditioned foresight, and show that predicted touch preserves contact-quality ordering. Project page: https://foretac.github.io/.
11.paper_essence: 提出 ForeTac：用 TacVAE 触觉表征 + 动作条件 Foresight Transformer 预测候选动作的未来多步触觉轨迹，再由接触质量评分器给出 good-vs-bad 边距，并把该边距经触觉预测器回传到冻结扩散/流匹配策略的采样状态以引导动作生成，四个真实机器人任务将平均 SR 从 36.3% 提升到 71.3%、CSR 从 20.0% 提升到 66.3%。
11.concept_bridging:
源概念: 推理时接触质量梯度引导（predictive contact guidance）：冻结基策略 + 可微触觉前瞻预测器 + 从成功/失败交互学到接触质量评分器，通过分类器引导式（classifier-guidance）梯度更新扩散/流匹配采样状态
目标概念: 用户研究中的 RGB-D 视觉语言条件扩散抓取位姿/动作序列生成：VLM 融合彩色、深度与语言指令形成语义表征，直接预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿或用扩散策略生成多模态抓取动作，并在真实机器人闭环执行
迁移机制: 保留 ForeTac 的四段循环结构，但替换信号载体：①表征——把 TacVAE 换成 RGB-D + 语言指令的 VLM 语义嵌入（可用点云/深度编码器作几何补充）；②预测——把 Foresight Transformer 的“候选动作→未来触觉潜变量”改为“候选抓取位姿/动作 chunk→未来深度图、实例分割或抓取接触区域的预测”，仍以候选动作为条件、以未来时间步为 query 对齐；③评估——把四类接触分类器的 logit 边距换成开放词汇评分器：以 VLM 计算候选抓取与语言指令的语义一致性、并用抓取可达性与稳定性标签训练排序/对比目标（而非固定四类交叉熵），得到可微的抓取质量分数；④引导——保持基抓取策略参数冻结，只在扩散/流匹配采样步上把质量分数对采样状态的梯度做归一化后注入（对应式 14–15、17–19）。需注意的关键差异：用户没有触觉传感器，评分器必须开放词汇且能处理未见物体，因此不能用任务特定的四类原型；ForeTac 的评分器是在同分布成功/失败数据上训练的，面对杂乱场景与遮挡会严重失配，需引入不确定性或只在预测置信度高时才施加引导；另外 ForeTac 的引导步长很小（DP 用 0.003、30 步中 10 步引导），迁移到抓取任务时需重新标定，避免破坏 6-DoF 位姿的旋转分量。
11.visual_verification: 视觉证据只覆盖图、不覆盖表，需区分事实层级。Figure 1 是概念示意图（人类握力预判 + 动作前预测并评分接触后果），无数值，只支撑动机而非结论。Figure 2 是框架图，明确画出 TacVAE 表征、动作条件未来触觉预测、接触质量打分三个训练模块与“参数冻结、梯度回传更新采样状态”的推理流程，支撑核心机制的结构性主张，但不提供性能证据。Figure 3 给出 Realman RM75 + Robotiq Hand-E + Vitai GF225 触觉传感器 + 两台 RealSense D405 的平台图与四任务（板擦拭、花瓶擦拭、卡片滑动、芯片抓取）执行序列，支撑“真实机器人、四类接触丰富任务”的设置主张，无成功率数值。[Image 4] 对 Figure 4(a) 的描述给出 305 次配对引导更新中 96.1%（正文称 293/305）接触质量边距提升、范围 −7.22 至 1.96，支撑“预测接触引导能把动作更新推向更优接触结果”；但 [Figure 4] 条目又称该面板数值不可辨认，两处描述不一致，该面板的可读性存疑。Figure 4(b) 的热图覆盖 1,024 个留出窗口、7 个关节 × 16 个未来动作步，色标约 0.0005–0.0020，梯度集中在 j2 与 j4（j4 在第 6–7 步最深）、j0/j6 接近零，支撑“接触质量梯度确实经预测器回传到具体关节与未来时间步”这一可微性主张。论文最核心的定量主张——Table I 的 SR/CSR 全面领先（DP 36.3%/20.0% → 71.3%/66.3%，RDP 58.8%/48.8%，π0.5 46.3%/36.3% → 67.5%/62.5%）、Table II 的消融（ResNet 编码器降 21.3/27.5 个点、预测重排序低于完整方法 12.5/13.8 个点）、Table III 的重建对比、Table IV 的动作掩码对照（0.0589→0.0941 latent MAE）、Table V 的前瞻视界扫描（L=1→16 时 SR 60%→85%）、Table VI 的偏好排序准确率（记录 91.2%、预测 92.9%/ρ=0.9321–0.9728）——在视觉证据中均无对应图表描述，只能依据正文判断，未获视觉核查。
11.relevance_reason: 契合点：ForeTac 的落点正是“冻结的扩散/流匹配策略 + 推理时外部评分梯度引导”，与用户 Idea 中“扩散策略生成抓取动作序列”这条路径共享同一生成式骨架；其式 14–15（扩散）与 17–19（流匹配）给出的归一化梯度注入方式、引导步的子集调度（30 步中 10 步、scale 0.003）以及“基策略参数冻结、只改采样状态”的部署形态，可以几乎原样搬到用户的抓取扩散策略上；论文在真实机器人上做闭环验证并报告 SR/CSR 双指标与计算开销（每次重规划 261.26 ms vs DP 132.46 ms），对用户的真实部署评测也有直接参考价值。差距：核心引导信号是触觉前瞻，用户只有单目 RGB-D、没有触觉，必须替换整个“预测—评估”环节；论文不涉及自然语言指令、6-DoF 抓取位姿检测、开放词汇、杂乱场景遮挡推理与未见物体泛化，任务也局限在四类预定义接触任务上；此外接触质量评分器是任务特定的四类分类器，与用户需要的开放词汇、类别无关抓取质量评估在监督形式与泛化要求上差异很大。因此属于相邻领域高质量工作、迁移路径清晰但需较多改造，定 6 分。
11.heuristic_suggestion: 1) 【把循环搬到抓取扩散策略】构建“RGB-D+VLM 表征—未来抓取结果预测—VLM 抓取质量评分—梯度引导”四段式：用冻结的抓取扩散策略产生候选 6-DoF 位姿/动作 chunk（保留前 8 步执行、滚动重规划，与 ForeTac 的 receding-horizon 一致）；训练一个以候选抓取位姿为条件的轻量预测器，输出未来深度图或抓取接触区域的潜表征（对应 Figure 2(b) 的 Foresight），并设置动作掩码对照（对应 Table IV）验证预测器确实使用了候选位姿而非仅外推历史。2) 【替换评分器为开放词汇可微分数】用 VLM 计算“候选抓取后的预测观测”与语言指令的语义匹配分，并与抓取可达性、遮挡程度组成复合分数，用成功/失败抓取对训练排序目标；按 Table VI 的做法在留出接触窗口上报告记录输入与预测输入下的偏好排序准确率与秩相关，先证明评分器在“预测结果”上仍保持质量排序，再上真机引导，避免用不可靠评分器误导采样。3) 【引导调度扫描】照搬 ForeTac 的小步长、子集引导策略，在用户扩散抓取策略上扫描引导步数比例（如 30 步中的 5/10/15 步）与归一化步长（0.001–0.01），并在流匹配骨架上复现“只在最后 2/10 积分步引导”的设置（正文报告 π0.5 增益 21.3/26.3 个点），以 SR/CSR 与位姿旋转误差为指标定位不破坏旋转分量的引导强度。4) 【引导有效性的离线诊断】复现 Figure 4(a) 式诊断：统计配对引导更新中质量边距提升的比例（论文为 293/305≈96.1%），并复现 Figure 4(b) 的梯度幅值热图，检查梯度是否落在与抓取接触相关的关节/时间步上；若梯度弥散或集中在无关自由度，说明评分器与预测器的可微通路存在问题。5) 【评测协议与泛化拆分】沿用论文的 20 次试验/任务、预设接触判据与成功率+接触成功率双指标，但按用户场景拆成“训练物体/未见物体 × 稀疏/杂乱堆叠”四组，报告各组 SR 与抓取位姿误差；同时记录单次重规划延迟，对照 ForeTac 的 +128.80 ms 开销，确认引导后仍满足真实抓取控制频率。6) 【失败恢复闭环】结合论文结论中承认的“任务特定质量模型”局限，在用户框架里加入预测置信度阈值：当预测器/评分器置信度低于阈值时不施加引导、退回基策略采样，作为对未见物体与遮挡场景的失败恢复机制，并做消融验证其必要性。

10.title: A Phenomenology of Neural Geometry in Vision-Language-Action Models
10.authors: Mozes Jacobs, Aiden Swann, Mathilde Papillon, Siddharth Boppana, Fenil R. Doshi, Usha Bhalla, Thomas Icard, Matt Feiszli, Thomas McGrath, Vasudev Shyam, Demba Ba, Leon Bergen, Nina Miolane, Owen Lewis, Jack Merullo, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Atticus Geiger, Matthew Kowal, Thomas Fel
10.abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. The same geometries reappear in two further VLA models on real-world robot data, indicating that they are neither model-specific nor artifacts of simulation. We demonstrate how the findings are actionable by steering along the geometry a concept realizes. Overall, this work lays out an initial phenomenology of realized geometry in VLA policies and demonstrates that a concept's shape carries as much importance as its readability.
10.paper_essence: 该研究用受控扫描、自然 rollout、线性探针与激活干预，刻画 VLA 策略（MolmoBot 及 π0.5/MolmoAct2）中七类操作概念在激活空间的“实现几何”：位置占近欧氏 3-D 子空间、腕部朝向因关节限位呈开弧、距离被拆成近正交的米级粗尺与厘米级细尺，并证明沿该几何编辑才有效（腕角编辑仍落在“信念”上并被策略补偿）。
10.concept_bridging:
源概念: realized geometry（概念实现几何）与配套的探针–秩曲线–擦除分析、流形/拉回（pullback）编辑，以及 Box 1 的“信念 vs 动作”区分
目标概念: 用户框架中 RGB-D 视觉语言语义表征到 6-DoF 抓取位姿/扩散动作序列的条件接口，以及抓取策略的表征级评测与失败恢复机制
迁移机制: 把“线性可读出 ≠ 结构正确 ≠ 可操控”的判据迁移到用户的抓取策略上：(1) 对目标物体 3D 位置、夹爪–目标距离、腕部旋转做秩曲线与探针，判断语义表征在遮挡/杂乱下的维度是否仍为 3（位置）/2–3（姿态），并据此设计位姿回归头与扩散条件向量的低秩 bottleneck；(2) 复现近/远双尺分离，把粗尺特征用于 approach 阶段条件、细尺特征用于 grasp 阶段条件，形成两阶段条件调制；(3) 借用 pullback 动作侧编辑做失败恢复（滑脱重抓时的夹爪翻转），而沿 belief 类几何（腕角）编辑会引发补偿，不能直接当控制量。需注意差异：论文不输入深度、不做 6-DoF 抓取位姿回归、不含杂乱遮挡与抓取成功率评测，探针标签依赖仿真真值；用户需自建基于 RGB-D 与真实抓取真值的标签管线，并把“几何诊断”与“抓取性能”显式关联。

9.title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
9.authors: Manav Kulshrestha, Apoorva Vashisth, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera
9.abstract: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) has emerged as an important skill for purposeful robotic manipulation. Given the task of using a knife to "slice bread," a robot must choose to grasp from the handle, whereas for "hand[ing] the knife over," it is preferable for the handle to remain unobstructed for safe handoff. Current approaches for TOG either focus on 2D planar grasping, remain limited by their reliance on task-agnostic grasp generators, or are constrained by reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets that cannot cover all possible grasp-task pairs. To that end, we present TGrasp6D, a vision-language based approach for generating task-oriented 6DoF grasps in a zero-shot manner. Given a task and a single RGB-D image of an associated object, TGrasp6D reasons about the appropriate semantic affordance for the given task and object geometry to produce an initial task- informed prior. This generated prior is further refined via 6DoF pose optimization for collision avoidance while preserving task consistency. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art success rate of 94% on the TaskGrasp dataset, with the best baseline at 74%. We also deploy our approach on a Franka Research 3 robot to demonstrate zero-shot generalization to real world objects
9.paper_essence: 提出零样本 6DoF 任务导向抓取框架 TGrasp6D：先用 VLM 将自然语言任务落地为图像空间的可供性点与抓取闭合轴，再借相机内外参将该信息提升为 3D 任务先验分布 N(μ,Σ)，并在 SE(3) 上以“碰撞规避 + 任务一致性 + 位姿增量正则”目标对采样候选进行批量姿态优化，在 TaskGrasp 上达 94.5% 成功率（最强基线 73.7%），并零样本迁移到 Franka Research 3 真机。

源概念: VLM 可供性定位 + 3D 提升 + SE(3) 位姿精炼的“先验—优化”范式（任务先验分布采样候选抓取，再由带碰撞 SDF 与任务场 ρ_τ 的目标函数精炼）
目标概念: 用户框架中“RGB-D 视觉语言感知模块 → 6-DoF 抓取位姿/扩散策略”的条件化与生成接口
迁移机制: 可直接把论文三段式流水线作为用户“直接预测 6-DoF 抓取位姿”分支的强基线：VLM 输出可供性点 t 与闭合轴 R，经内参 K、外参 T 提升为 3D 线/平面，构造 N(μ,Σ) 任务先验，再用论文 Eq.(7)-(10) 的碰撞项 + 任务一致性项 + 正则项做姿态优化。对用户的“扩散策略”分支，可把该 N(μ,Σ) 作为扩散去噪过程的初始均值/条件分布或奖励引导项，使多模态抓取序列被约束在任务相关区域，同时保留扩散的多峰采样能力。需注意差异：论文依赖物体掩码+紧裁剪 I_o 处理单物体，用户需在实例分割、遮挡推理后对每个候选物体分别构造该先验，并把论文 SDF 碰撞项扩展为“物体间/场景点云”避碰与可达性约束；论文只输出单个 6DoF 抓取，不含动作序列与闭环执行，迁移到机械臂轨迹与失败恢复需另接运动规划器与在线重规划。

8.title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
8.authors: Lei Zhu, Mujie Lin, Ruochong Zheng, Guangyi Wang, Hao Li, Peng Jin, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
8.abstract: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.
8.paper_essence: 提出 BeziCast：用低阶 Bézier 轨迹对输出邻近去噪表示做免训练跨步预测，通过 Tikhonov 正则化拟合控制点、并用等效权重凸包护栏抑制外推风险，在 FLUX.1/HunyuanVideo 上取得最高 4.79×/4.11× 加速且画质优于缓存基线。
8.concept_bridging:
源概念: 输出邻近表示的 Bézier 轨迹预测 + Tikhonov 稳定拟合 + 等效权重凸包护栏（cache-then-forecast）
目标概念: 视频 DiT 跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用/预测与 token 剪枝的误差控制
迁移机制: 可把每个去噪步、每层、每注意力头的 K/V 或注意力输出视为时间轨迹：用最近若干完整步的 K/V 拟合低阶 Bézier，在缓存步预测被跳过或延迟更新的 K/V；Tikhonov 正则化用于抑制短历史外推的噪声放大，等效权重 r(u_s) 可转化为层/头/token 级风险分数，高风险时回退到最近步 KV 或保守凸组合。对 token 剪枝，可把预测残差与等效权重风险结合 token 重要性，低风险 token 复用/合并、高风险 token 保留计算。关键差异是：论文只预测单一输出邻近表示，而 K/V 是多层多头多 token 张量且动态不同；KV 复用必须兼容注意力 softmax，凸包护栏更适合放在注意力输出空间而非直接约束 K/V；论文跳过整个 backbone，用户只跳过部分 KV/token，误差传播与加速比不同。Figure 6(b) 的层间鲁棒性结果提示可对后层更激进、前层更保守。

7.title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
7.authors: Jiyue Jiang, Zhiyu Huo, Yuhan Chen, Yanruisheng Shao, Gong Zhang, Lei Deng
7.abstract: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.
7.paper_essence: 提出 AlignCache 闭环特征缓存框架：按去噪阶段分配独立阈值与陈旧度护栏，利用 CFG 引导输出上的反事实误差在线校准缓存决策，并用门控动量残差外推与锚点引导的无条件校正提升跳过步保真度，从而在多个视频 DiT 上取得更优加速-质量权衡。
7.concept_bridging:
源概念: 面向视频扩散去噪步间冗余的闭环特征缓存：分阶段预算路由、反事实误差校准、动量残差草稿合成
目标概念: 视频 DiT 的跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用与注意力头/Token 剪枝的自适应调度
迁移机制: 可将 AlignCache 的“预算—阈值—反馈”控制器迁移为 KV/Token 复用控制器：用分阶段阈值决定各层/头/Token 的 KV 复用年龄与剪枝率；在强制精确步上构造反事实的复用/剪枝输出，并在 CFG 引导输出层计算相对 MSE 作为真实失真，经 EMA 反比更新阈值；陈旧度护栏可直接限制 KV 复用步数，动量残差外推可用于预测漂移的 KV 或 token 显著性。需注意差异：论文缓存的是分支输出残差而非 KV 张量，反馈粒度为整步而非层/头/Token，且未处理 token 剪枝后的布局与内核效率；迁移时需增加头级/Token 级 profiling，并避免把仅适用于 CFG 双分支的校正直接套到 KV 压缩。

6.title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
6.authors: Xiaoxue Wu, Xinyu Gao, Fang Yu, Yu Qiao, Xinyuan Chen
6.abstract: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
6.paper_essence: 提出注意力对齐的在线聚类 KV Cache 与 query-head 级细粒度检索：把历史 token 按语义相似度在线聚成簇（head 独立、Pre-RoPE 空间），再让每个 query-head 对在固定检索预算下各自选簇，从而在压缩记忆预算下近似全历史注意力，提升自回归多镜头长视频的跨镜头一致性。
6.concept_bridging:
源概念: 在线聚类 KV Cache + query-wise/head-wise 稀疏检索（基于注意力分析得到的 query-head 异构记忆偏好，在固定 cluster 预算下近似 full-memory attention）
目标概念: 视频 DiT 推理加速中的头级稀疏性建模、KV Cache 稀疏化/合并与 token（簇）级剪枝
迁移机制: CineMem 的检索本质是“以语义簇为单位的稀疏注意力”：不为每个 query 计算全部历史 KV，而是用 query 与簇质心的相似度选 top-K 簇再拼接注意力。可将该机制移植为视频 DiT 的稀疏注意力/剪枝算子——(1) 把帧级或块级 KV 分组替换为 head-wise 在线聚类分组，得到比 frame/block 更细的剪枝粒度；(2) 保留其 head 独立聚类与 head 独立路由，直接承载“头级异构稀疏性”假设；(3) 借用 Pre-RoPE 语义路由、Post-RoPE 参与注意力的解耦，避免 3D RoPE 破坏语义聚类；(4) 借用簇 split/merge、负载惩罚与分配一致性项，作为长序列 KV 合并的稳定性控制；(5) 借用 log-sum-exp 归一化合并两路注意力，使稀疏检索结果不引入独立残差偏差。需注意三点差异：第一，CineMem 是 chunk 级自回归生成，KV 沿时间轴单调增长，而用户是双向视频 DiT 的迭代去噪，注意力非因果、需处理全序列 3D 注意力，因此“历史记忆”要改为“帧内/跨帧 token 集合”；第二，CineMem 完全未涉及去噪步间冗余，跨步 KV 复用需另建相似度判据与误差控制；第三，CineMem 的聚类路由是逐 query 的 gather，会带来非规则访存开销（Table 1 中 cluster 检索开销 15.018 TFLOPs，远高于 frame 检索 0.0453 TFLOPs），迁移到 GPU 内核时须限制簇数量并做 layout 重排，否则算法 FLOPs 下降未必转化为墙钟加速。

5.title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
5.authors: Or Ronai, Vladimir Kulikov, Tomer Michaeli
5.abstract: Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.
5.paper_essence: 提出用隐式随机 Hadamard 字典替代稠密高斯码本，并结合无表词典编码与重编码尾部 KV Cache 刷新，实现图像/视频生成式压缩的 O(d log d) 投影重建和近实时流式视频压缩。
5.concept_bridging:
源概念: 隐式随机 Hadamard 字典（FWHT 投影/重建）、过完备多基字典，以及 re-encoded-tail KV-cache refresh
目标概念: 视频 DiT 的 KV Cache 压缩/复用、长视频缓存刷新、注意力头稀疏性评分与 token 剪枝
迁移机制: 可将 FWHT 作为无参数、O(d log d) 的随机正交投影，用于 KV 特征降维、跨步 KV 相似度估计或低秩压缩；将 re-encoded-tail 刷新迁移为长视频生成中定期用最近生成帧重算 KV 前缀，以限制缓存长度并维持时序一致。需要注意：论文面向压缩码流而非生成加速，其 KV Cache 是自回归视频模型跨片段上下文缓存，不是去噪步内注意力 KV；论文也未建模头级重要性和 token 显著性，迁移时必须在视频 DiT 的每层、每头、每个去噪步上重新定义重要性评分、误差补偿与预算分配。
5.visual_verification: Figure 2 在 FLUX/DIV2K 上标注 Ours 为 0.014/0.019 BPP、42/44 秒、0.01 GiB，而 Turbo-DDCM 为 0.013–0.022 BPP、48–69 秒、8.1–9.3 GiB，支持“最快且避免显式码本内存开销”的主张；Figure 3 在 MCL-JCV/UVG 上显示 H-DDCM OC(B=8) 的 PSNR 居中、DOVER 约 0.60 居前、FVMD 较低，编码/解码 FPS 约 12–13/15 为最高，支持吞吐最高和率失真感知具竞争力的结论；Figure 4 定性显示本文在 0.0022 BPP 下较好保留船体、旗帜和水面细节，ST 切片纹理连续，而 ZeroGVC 在 I 帧边界出现断裂，支持时序一致性主张；Image 6 显示 SSIM/LPIPS/耗时随 BPP 变化，Ours 率失真接近或优于 Turbo-DDCM 且耗时低 1–2 个量级，支持计算开销降低。但给定视觉证据未直接验证 O(d log d) 复杂度、无表词典编码的位流正确性、KV-cache refresh 消融（Figure S17/S18 未在视觉证据中）以及头级稀疏性/token 剪枝（论文未涉及）。
5.relevance_reason: 论文的视频部分与用户研究都使用自回归视频扩散/流模型并涉及 KV Cache 管理，re-encoded-tail 刷新可迁移到长视频生成的缓存控制；Hadamard 投影可为 KV 压缩或跨步相似度估计提供廉价正交变换。但论文核心是生成式压缩码流，不是视频 DiT 推理加速；没有注意力头稀疏性、跨去噪步 KV 复用、token 剪枝或 GPU 内核协同，实验指标是压缩率/PSNR/FID/FVMD/吞吐，而非生成延迟和显存峰值，因此只能中等相关。
5.heuristic_suggestion: 1）Hadamard-KV 压缩实验：在 Open-Sora/CogVideoX 等视频 DiT 上，对每层每头 K/V 沿特征维做随机 Hadamard 投影到 r=64/128/256 维，比较“投影空间注意力”与“投影后重建 KV”两种方案，并对比 SVD/PCA/量化基线；指标用 FVD、VBench、PSNR/LPIPS、峰值显存和每步延迟，消融单基与 B=2/4/8 过完备多基。依据 Figure 2 中 0.01 GiB 对 8.1–9.3 GiB 的隐式字典内存优势，验证无参数投影能否替代显式 KV 压缩。2）长视频 KV 刷新实验：将 re-encoded-tail 刷新迁移到长视频生成，每 N 帧用最近若干生成帧重算 KV 前缀，与硬重置、无限增长缓存对比；测 FVMD、ST 切片连续性、峰值显存和额外重算开销，参考 Figure 4 的 ST 切片连续性作为定性评价方式。3）头级跨步复用实验：用 Hadamard 投影后的 KV 余弦相似度作为头级复用评分，每层选 top-p 头复用上一步 KV、其余头更新，并加入残差补偿；对比随机选择、幅度评分和注意力熵评分，报告不同去噪阶段的复用率、FVD/VBench 与端到端延迟。4）Token 剪枝实验：结合时空注意力响应、跨步一致性和 token 特征能量估计重要性，对低贡献 token 执行剪枝/合并，并设计随去噪阶段变化的剪枝调度；指标包括 VBench 时序一致性、FVD、吞吐和显存峰值。5）系统协同实验：实现 fused Hadamard 投影+KV 读取+注意力内核，优化 KV 内存布局与批处理，测量端到端生成时延、显存峰值和吞吐，验证算法收益能否转化为实际加速。

4.title: StreamErase: Towards Ultra-Fast Streaming Video Erasing
4.authors: Zhuobai Dong, Xiaobing Tu, Xiantao Zhang, Jinkui Ren, Yinggui Wang, Yue Ma, Linfeng Zhang
4.abstract: Current video object removal methods suffer from prohibitive latency (minutes per video) and non-causal processing that prevents real-time interaction. We present StreamErase, enabling sub-second latency with up to 26 FPS streaming generation on a single GPU. Our approach first augments a text-to-video model with mask input to generate high-quality videos that erase target objects and synthesize coherent backgrounds, but does not perform inference on the fly. As such, we progressively transfer the erasing capability from a powerful bidirectional foundation model to an efficient unidirectional streaming eraser, enabling long-horizon erasing without sacrificing visual fidelity. Several key challenges arise when generating videos over long, potentially infinite horizons: (1) bridging the domain gap from training on finite length and extrapolating to long horizons, (2) sustaining high quality by preventing error accumulation, and (3) maintaining fast inference, without increasing computational cost as the context grows. To address these challenges, we carefully designed sliding-window causal attention with attention sinks. By incorporating self-rollout with attention sinks and KV cache rolling during training, we simulate inference-time extrapolations with a fixed context window, enabling constant-speed generation of arbitrarily long videos. Finally, we establish a dedicated benchmark, LongErase, for streaming long-video object removal. Our model achieves strong performance compared to existing video object erasing models and generalizes well to real-world video scenarios, uniquely enabling infinite-length streaming. With StreamErase, users can input a mask and see the erasing results unfold in real-time, delivering a truly interactive experience.
4.paper_essence: 提出 StreamErase：先训练双向视频擦除教师模型，再经「因果化教师强制 → ODE 4 步蒸馏 → DMD 单步蒸馏」三阶段把擦除能力迁移到单向流式学生模型，并用滑动窗口因果注意力 + 注意力 sink + 滚动 KV Cache 在固定上下文预算下实现恒定成本的无限长视频流式擦除（单卡 H200 上 0.87s 延迟、26.06 FPS）。
4.concept_bridging:
源概念: 固定预算的滑动窗口因果注意力 + 初始帧注意力 sink + 滚动 KV Cache（训练期用 self-rollout 模拟推理外推），以及由此得到的经验结论：最小配置（sink=1、window=1、chunk=3）长时稳定性最优，扩大窗口反而因历史误差累积而变差。
目标概念: 视频 DiT 跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用与 token 剪枝中的「缓存预算分配 / 淘汰策略」：哪些 token 的 KV 应作为锚点长期保留、哪些应随步数滚动淘汰、复用跨度多大才不致放大误差。
迁移机制: 可将「attention sink = 不可驱逐锚点 token」直接迁移为跨步 KV 复用中的持久 KV 集合（如每段起始帧 / 高注意力响应 token 的 KV 永不压缩、其余 token 按窗口滚动延迟更新或低秩压缩），把「滑动窗口 + 滚动淘汰」映射为按去噪步推进的 KV 淘汰调度。需注意三点差异：(1) 论文的滚动发生在自回归 chunk 之间（时间轴外推），而我们要复用的是同一采样内相邻去噪步之间（噪声轴冗余），误差累积来源不同但「长历史反而有害」的结论提示复用跨度应保守；(2) 论文的 sink 是为抗长时漂移，我们的复用是为省算力，sink 可作为误差控制手段（复用 KV 时保留锚点以抑制漂移）；(3) 论文用蒸馏把 NFE 压到 1，本身会削减跨步复用的收益空间，因此跨步 KV 复用必须与「步数压缩」联合评估而非独立假设。
4.visual_verification: 视觉证据支持以下核心主张：Figure 1 直接支撑效率主张（Ours 0.87s 延迟、26.06 FPS，对比 VACE/ROSE/EffectErase/DiffuEraser 的 61.23–204.07s 与 0.57–1.93 FPS，标注 234.56× 延迟、45.72× 帧率差距）；Table 1 支撑「精度不降且更快」（ROSE PSNR 32.791、SSIM 0.928、LPIPS 0.063、FVD 56.294，FPS 26.06，优于 EffectErase/ROSE），但注意 VOR-Eval 上并非全面最优（PSNR 22.494 < EffectErase 22.792，FVD 344.846 > 335.497），论文「competitive」措辞与表格一致但非全面领先；Table 2 支撑长时稳定性（30s 视频 δ_Drift^Quality=0.05，VBench 各项与 5s 接近）；Table 3 支撑三阶段蒸馏的必要性（NFE 100→8→1，延迟 130.16→1.35→0.87，SSIM 0.925→0.903→0.928，说明 Stage2 掉点、Stage3 恢复）；Figure 5 与 Table 5 支撑 attention sink/窗口消融结论（c3s1w1 LPIPS 0.163、漂移 0.05 最优；去 sink 0.254/0.27，chunk=1 0.319/0.72，sliding window 0.181/0.08），Figure 5 的 LPIPS-时间曲线与「至少一个 sink chunk 关键、更大窗口变差」一致；Table 4 支撑 EE loss 与 MMRG 的有效性（PSNR 30.104→32.571→31.613→32.791）。缺乏定量支撑的部分：Figure 2、Figure 3 仅架构/流程示意无任何数值（三阶段步数可辨但无量化）；Figure 6 为长视频与交互 Demo 可视化，无可读帧率/延迟数值，因此「真正交互式体验」只能由 Figure 1 与 Table 1/5 的离线测速间接支撑，缺少端到端交互时延的实测图表；正文提到的「46× faster」在表格中对应与 VACE（0.57 FPS）比较，未对最强基线 EffectErase（1.51 FPS，约 17×）给出同等倍率说明。
4.relevance_reason: 契合点：本文是视频 DiT 推理加速的直接同类工作，且其加速手段之一正是 KV Cache 管理——滑动窗口 + attention sink + 滚动缓存 + 训练期 self-rollout 对齐推理，与用户「KV Cache 复用/淘汰策略」高度同构；其「窗口越大、历史越长反而漂移越严重」的消融（Figure 5、Table 5）为用户的复用跨度与误差累积控制提供了可直接引用的经验规律；Table 1/Table 3 给出了延迟、FPS、NFE 阶梯的完整评测范式，可作为基线对比与指标模板。差距：论文的加速主体来自「因果化 + 两阶段步数蒸馏（50→4→1 NFE）」，而非头级稀疏性或 token 剪枝，全文未涉及注意力头重要性 profiling、头间冗余、token 合并/剪枝；其 KV 复用是沿时间轴跨 chunk 的，而非用户核心关注的「跨去噪步 KV 复用」；且 1-step 化会显著压缩跨步复用的潜在收益，这一点论文未讨论，需要用户自行补足实验。故评为 7 分：相邻同任务的高质量工作，迁移路径清晰但需较大改造与重新定位。
4.heuristic_suggestion: 建议按以下编号实验推进：(1) 头级稀疏性 profiling 实验：在 Wan2.1 类视频 DiT 上，对每个注意力头统计相邻去噪步之间 K/V 的余弦相似度与「置零该头 KV 更新后输出的 LPIPS 增量」，得到头重要性-冗余二维分布图；验证是否存在「高相似且低敏感」的可跳过头集合（预期可跳过 20–30% 头的 KV 更新），参考本文 Table 3 的 NFE/延迟报告格式同步给出加速比。(2) sink 锚定的跨步 KV 复用：把本文的 attention sink 改造为跨去噪步的「持久 KV 集合」（每段首帧 token 或高注意力响应 token 不参与延迟更新），窗口内 token 采用「延迟 k 步更新 + 残差补偿」，直接复用 Figure 5 的 LPIPS-时间曲线作为稳定性评测模板，报告复用跨度 k=1/2/4 时的漂移曲线；预期结论应与本文一致——复用跨度过大反而放大误差。(3) 缓存预算与剪枝联合消融：仿照 Table 5 的 c3s1w1 网格，做 (sink 比例 × 复用跨度 × token 保留率) 的三维消融，指标包含 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/FVD（Table 1 协议）+ VBench 的 Motion Smoothness / Background Consistency / Temporal Flickering（Table 2 协议）+ 自定义 δ_Drift（首尾 5 秒成像质量差，本文 Table 2 已给出 0.05 作为参考基线）。(4) 与步数压缩的交互实验：在 NFE=50/8/4/1 四档（对应本文 Table 3 的 Stage1/Stage2/Stage3 阶梯）下分别测量跨步 KV 复用与 token 剪枝带来的额外加速与画质损失，明确「复用收益随 NFE 下降而衰减」的边界，这是本文未覆盖但对用户贡献至关重要的空白点。(5) 系统级实现：把上述策略落到分块流式推理内核，报告显存峰值、吞吐（FPS）与延迟的 Pareto 前沿，与 StreamErase 的 0.87s/26.06 FPS 在相同分辨率（832×480）与相同硬件（H200）下做公平对比，并补充本文缺失的端到端交互时延实测（Figure 6 仅有 Demo 界面，无可读延迟数据）。

3.title: Sparse Attention for Video Generation Acceleration via Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search
3.authors: Yun Dai, Yuyun Chen, Jiarui Wen, Huiping Zhuang, Cen Chen, Ziqian Zeng
3.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) dominate video generation but suffer from high inference cost due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Sparse attention mitigates this by skipping unnecessary computation in the attention matrix, but existing methods apply a fixed sparsity ratio throughout denoising and struggle to accurately determine which computations to skip. To address these limitations, we analyze attention dynamics through attention entropy and mean attention distance, and find that attention becomes increasingly concentrated across denoising steps. We further observe that blocks selected early continue to capture a large fraction of the total attention weight at later steps. These findings suggest two acceleration opportunities: the sparsity ratio should grow as denoising progresses, and earlier search results can be reused to reduce the search space. Based on these findings, we propose Growing Sparsity and Reduced Search (GSRS), a training-free framework that retains more computation early and progressively reduces it later, while restricting subsequent searches to an early candidate set to reduce search overhead. GSRS adopts Top-p selection for adaptive sparsity control, supported by a precise evaluation scheme that computes exact attention weights within the FlashAttention computation at negligible overhead. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan 2.1 validate that GSRS achieves 1.55$\times$--2.21$\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality comparable to full attention.
3.paper_essence: 通过注意力熵与平均注意力距离发现去噪过程中注意力逐步集中，提出免训练框架 GSRS：用递减的 Top-p 阈值实现随去噪步递增的块稀疏度，并把后续块搜索限制在早期建立的候选块集合内（reduced search），配合融合进 FlashAttention 的两阶段精确块重要性评估，在 HunyuanVideo/Wan2.1 上实现 1.55×–2.21× 加速且画质接近全注意力。
3.concept_bridging:
源概念: 跨去噪步复用早期候选块集合（Reduced Search：S1 建立后，后续搜索只在 S1 内重评估，非搜索步直接复用最近掩码）+ 基于累积注意力概率（Top-p）的头/层自适应稀疏度 + 用当前行 LSE 而非缓存 LSE 的精确块重要性评估
目标概念: 用户 Idea 中的『去噪步间 KV Cache 复用』『注意力头级稀疏性评分』与『随去噪阶段变化的 token 剪枝调度』
迁移机制: 三点可直接映射：(1) 论文的『第 t1 步建立候选块集 S1、后续只在该集合内搜索、非搜索步直接复用上次掩码』→ 改造为『早期步用全注意力统计各层各头的 token 级累积注意力概率，建立 KV 复用候选集，后续搜索步只在候选集内重评估，非搜索步直接复用上一步 KV/重要性掩码』，这本质上是把论文的“结构复用”升级为“结构+KV 张量复用”；(2) 论文的递减 Top-p 阈值序列 → 改造为递减的 KV 保留率/剪枝率调度，用累积注意力概率自动决定每个头保留多少 token，替代统一的固定预算（Table 5 显示 Top-p 优于等密度 Top-k，说明头自适应分配有效）；(3) 论文用当前步 LSE 校正块重要性、避免 cached LSE 漂移（Table 3：改用缓存 LSE 后 PSNR 从 31.96 掉到 25.32）→ 直接对应 KV 复用中的误差累积控制，可用“当前步 LSE/统计量做重标定 + 残差补偿”替代朴素复用。需要注意的差异：论文只跳过块级计算、不压缩 KV 存储也不减少 token 数，用户的 KV 复用还需处理显存布局、低秩压缩与写回开销；论文依赖 Hilbert 重排与 B=128 的块对齐、且需要至少 1 步（默认 20% 步）全注意力 warmup，迁移时须保留这一约束并评估重排/对齐开销；论文的固定掩码召回率仅 0.81–0.86（Figure 2），若 KV 复用追求更激进的压缩，需要显式设定更高 recall 目标以免画质下降。
3.visual_verification: 有视觉证据支持的核心主张：(1) Figure 2 给出固定稀疏掩码下的召回率随去噪步单调上升（Wan2.1-14B 约 0.811→0.855，HunyuanVideo 约 0.811→0.838，均高于 0.81），直接支撑 Observation 2 与 Reduced Search 的可行性；(2) Figure 3 的块级注意力热图定性显示高权重块由分散趋于集中、早期高权重块后期仍高权重，支撑“早期候选集可复用”，但无定量数值；(3) Figure 4 为框架示意，展示 Growing Sparsity 与 Reduced Search 的流程（搜索全部块→候选集内搜索→掩码复用），无具体数值，仅作机制说明；(4) Figure 5(c) 显示 A800 上每步核延迟随密度近似线性增长，全注意力恒约 800 ms，GSRS 搜索步在密度约 0.8 以下低于全注意力、约 0.8 处交叉、更高密度时因评估开销略超全注意力，支撑“融合块重要性评估开销较小”但有密度上限；(5) Figure 11 的 HunyuanVideo head 级 MAD 热图显示各行随去噪单调下降但行间亮度差异明显，支撑“头间行为多样 + 共同收敛趋势”，为头级自适应稀疏提供依据。缺乏图表核查的部分：Figure 1（熵/MAD 主曲线）的曲线数值、Figure 7 的 13.75× 搜索开销降低、以及 Table 1–13 的所有定量结果（加速比、PSNR、VBench-Q、密度、显存 65.60 vs 62.65 GB）在视觉证据中均未提供，仅能依据正文与表格文本判断，建议将其视为文本证据而非图形证据。

2.title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
2.authors: Qiuhong Shen, Shizun Wang, Xinchao Wang
2.abstract: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.
2.paper_essence: 提出一种无需训练的视频世界模型注意力路由机制：把历史 KV 块表示为带深度区间的相机视锥板，用视锥板 OBB 重叠软性调制各层模型自身的块重要性，从而对当前潜变量区域做块级稀疏 KV 选择；在 48 个 chunk 时注意力加速 4.36×、去噪加速 2.43×，质量接近稠密注意力。

目标概念: 视频 DiT 中按层/头/token 块的 KV Cache 选择、剪枝与跨去噪步复用

1.title: Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention for Efficient Inference in T2I/T2V Diffusion Transformers
1.authors: Bingxin Xing, Yu Zhang, Jiatong Ding, Lei Lu, Ping Wang
1.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a common backbone for high-quality text-to-image and text-to-video generation, but repeated dense self-attention remains a major inference bottleneck as token sequences grow and the same operator is invoked across many denoising steps. Our study suggests that dense attention in pretrained DiTs contains reusable layer/head-specific high-mass structure that can be identified from a small offline calibration set and reused across future generations. This leads to Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention, a train-free attention replacement that reuses static sink masks and supplements them with a lightweight pooled-KV branch, while leaving model weights and sampling schedules unchanged. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, the method attains 1.54$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining generation quality. On Z-Image-Turbo, it attains 1.57$\times$ end-to-end speedup with competitive GenEval2 performance. These results indicate that reusable importance-aware sparse support can provide an effective train-free acceleration path for both T2V and T2I DiTs.
1.paper_essence: 提出免训练的 Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention：离线校准层/头级静态 sink 块掩码并跨去噪步复用，配合 pooled-KV 补偿分支与归一化感知融合，在 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 与 Z-Image-Turbo 上分别实现 1.54× 和 1.57× 端到端加速。
1.concept_bridging:

目标概念: 视频 DiT 中注意力头级稀疏性评分、跨去噪步 KV Cache 复用决策、低贡献 token 的剪枝/合并/压缩近似
迁移机制: 可将论文的离线校准流程迁移为头级重要性先验：用每个 layer/head 的 block-mass 覆盖率与掩码密度刻画头稀疏性，高覆盖头保留更精确的 KV 并优先跨步复用，低覆盖头采用 pooled-KV 或低秩近似；论文的 pooled-KV 补偿分支可作为被复用/压缩 KV 的粗粒度兜底，α_i 归一化融合可改造成跨步复用的误差补偿门控。关键差异是：论文的静态 mask 作用于注意力计算而非 KV Cache 存储，pooled-KV 是每次前向现算的压缩分支而非跨步缓存，且没有 token 级动态剪枝与误差累积控制；迁移时需加入跨步 KV 相似度、延迟更新策略和时序一致性约束。

它是否属于 7-8 档？“相邻领域的高质量工作，如视觉语言模型用于机器人操作、扩散策略用于机械臂动作生成、开放词汇抓取检测、RGB-D 感知与抓取规划，迁移路径清晰。”嗯，ForeTac 是扩散策略用于机械臂动作生成——使用推理时引导。它与用户想法共享“扩散策略生成机械臂动作序列”这一部分，但引导信号是触觉，而用户没有触觉。而且用户要做 6-DoF 抓取位姿生成和语言。所以更接近 6 档或 7 档。让我权衡一下。
